scope: The public Pošta Slovenije addressing page, its current normal-postcode CSV and special-postcode PDF endpoint, and the GURS public-access, RPE, terms, WFS capabilities, schema, index and all 466 poštni okoliš geometries were audited without provider contact, registration, authentication, terms or contract acceptance, access-control bypass, protected query submission, publication destination or deployment.

countryIdentity.rule: Slovenia retains repository SI and ledger region Europe. Pošta Slovenije assignment authority, GURS postal-district spatial-register authority, address, building, parcel, administrative and operational-delivery identities remain separate; no source identity, territory or coverage was changed, merged or reassigned.

m2Definition.definition: A current complete Pošta Slovenije four-digit normal and special-code denominator is usable under explicit reviewed AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public-serving permission. Every area code is joined by an explicit versioned code/identifier crosswalk to a valid GURS poštni okoliš Polygon/MultiPolygon, while organization, institution, postal-centre, P.O.-box, route, point, unmatched and other source-defined non-area records remain explicit. The approved immutable artifact pins provider, release/reference date, rights, attribution, byte length, SHA-256, schema, source CRS, reviewed transform, coverage, conflicts and exceptions. The real SI API/app normalizes optional SI- input to four text digits, returns only valid real areas, fits and renders translucent fill with a clear outline, and displays selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence. No absence of geometry, Point, delivery-service area, administrative boundary, building/parcel object, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster or synthetic proxy satisfies M2.

officialObservations.finding: The current Pošta Slovenije addressing page links a normal-postcode CSV and a special-postcode PDF. The CSV returned HTTP 200 with Last-Modified 2026-07-01 09:45:14 GMT; the current special-postcode PDF link returned HTTP 404 with a 744-byte error body. No cached or indexed copy was substituted for the missing current body.

The Windows-1250 semicolon CSV contains 570 rows and 569 unique four-digit codes; code 1002 occurs twice for Ljubljana and Ljubljana postal centre. Public download availability establishes an exact observed assignment body, not explicit AGID redistribution or public-serving permission.

The exact official link returned HTTP 404 during this audit. The missing current body prevents source-defined classification of the 103 operator codes that have no GURS postal-district geometry; absence from the geometry service was not treated as proof of organization, postal-centre or other non-area status.

GURS describes unregistered free public services, WFS real-time vector access, WMS layer SI.GURS.RPE:POSTNI_OKOLISI and CC BY 4.0 use including sharing and adaptation with GURS, data-type and date/reference attribution. These rights cover GURS data, not Pošta Slovenije assignment data.

GURS lists poštni okoliš as a Register prostorskih enot spatial-unit class and points to free graphical layers through public access. This is official spatial-register geometry, kept separate from operator assignment, deliverability and special-code authority.

WFS 2.0 capabilities updateSequence 3921 declares SI.GURS.RPE:POSTNI_OKOLISI with default CRS urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::3794. The schema exposes EID_POSTNI_OKOLIS, SIFRA, NAZIV, GEOM and date fields. Ten ordered 50-feature pages captured every 466 features in EPSG:4326 JSON.

rightsAssessment.note: This is a conservative engineering gate, not legal advice. GURS CC BY 4.0 does not license Pošta Slovenije assignments, and public CSV availability is not silently widened into AGID redistribution or public-serving permission.

blockerSummary: GURS provides 466 valid official postal-district Polygon/MultiPolygon features under CC BY 4.0, and every GURS code occurs in the current Pošta Slovenije normal-postcode CSV. However, 103 Pošta codes have no GURS geometry, the official current special-code PDF needed to classify them returns HTTP 404, and no explicit Pošta permission compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving was established. No approved immutable artifact, real SI loader/API or map area path can be promoted.
unblockConditions: Obtain the exact current Pošta Slovenije special-code release or an equivalent authoritative denominator that source-defines every organization, institution, postal-centre, P.O.-box, route, point, unmatched and other non-area exception; pin its version/date, bytes, SHA-256, schema and correction policy.

Establish explicit written terms compatible with AGID processing, storage, reproducible crosswalk/derivation, redistribution and public serving for the Pošta assignment and exception data; provider contact, registration, agreement or contract acceptance requires explicit approval.

Reconcile all 569 operator codes and duplicate 1002 rows to the 466 GURS postal-district features or explicit source-defined non-area reasons, review the six normalized name mismatches, preserve source identity, and validate every geometry, gap, conflict and exception without Point, delivery-area, administrative, building, parcel, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster or synthetic proxies.
Build and publish only an approved immutable artifact, then pass real SI normalization, loader, API validity, map fit, translucent fill, outline, provenance, clear and re-search verification.
